tick() { # repo path recorded-rev recorded-pin
  r="$1"; p="$2"; rec="$3"; pin="$4"; d="/tmp/tameshi-r17w3-RR3-DeW0UG/fleet/$r"
  tip=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --verify --quiet --end-of-options "refs/heads/master^{commit}") || { echo "$1 SETUP rc2"; return; }
  recblob=$(git -C "$d" show "$rec:$p" 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -c1-8) || recblob=MISSING
  tipblob=$(git -C "$d" show "$tip:$p" 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -c1-8) || tipblob=MISSING
  liveblob=$(sha256sum "$d/$p" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-8) || liveblob=MISSING
  if git -C "$d" merge-base --is-ancestor "$rec" "$tip" 2>/dev/null; then anc=yes; else anc=no; fi
  dr=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain -- "$p" | wc -l)
  [ "$liveblob" = "$tipblob" ] || dr=$((dr+1))
  if [ "$rec" = "$tip" ]; then rel=current; elif [ "$anc" = yes ] && [ "$pin" != "$tipblob" ]; then rel=stale; else rel=mixed; fi
  printf "%-22s %s rec:%s tip:%s live:%s pin==tip:%s anc:%s porc:%s %s\n" "$r/$p" "${rec:0:8}" "$recblob" "$tipblob" "$liveblob" "$([ "$pin" = "$tipblob" ] && echo == || echo !=)" "$anc" "$dr" "$rel"
}
